name: Claude Code Setup
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI, adds the Claude Code VS Code extension, and drops a CLAUDE.md, settings.json and skills into the container

installCli.description: Install the Claude Code CLI using the official native installer

installSettings.description: Copy the bundled settings.json to ~/.claude/settings.json, denying the file tools access to .env files

installSkills.description: Copy the bundled skills to ~/.claude/skills, making them available in every project in the container
